title: Millcreek 3D buildings with roof forms (2023 lidar), planning estimate
snippet: Unvalidated planning estimate: 21,561 buildings from 2023 lidar, with roofer LoD 2.2 roofs and Esri LOD2.0/LOD1.2 fallbacks. Roof forms and heights are modelled, not surveyed or field-verified.
description:
The LEVEL field says which model each building uses, and the roof attributes (planes, slopes, azimuth, ridge and eave height, south-facing area) apply where LEVEL is roofer LoD2.2. Heights NAVD88; the package is labelled EGM96 but its heights were left in NAVD88 (see the scene-layers README).

Unvalidated LiDAR planning estimate from the 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 lidar (flown October-November 2023); not surveyed or field-verified data.

Coordinates: NAD83(2011) taken to WGS84 / Web Mercator with WGS_1984_(ITRF08)_To_NAD_1983_2011, the same as every layer in this set. Elevations NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres.

Records: canopy-toolbox/reviews/2026-10-22 in buschbrian/agol-python-scripts (branch canopy/classification-refinement). See ../2026-10-23/lod2-check/README.md.
accessInformation: Millcreek GIS; lidar: 2023 Salt Lake Valley QL1 (USGS 3DEP).
